designs.artworkPrompt: Give me an image with a stone golem in low poly style with a matte finish and no effect. Use a background that is visually related to the stone golem. No borders, no frames. The stone golem should be horizontally and vertically centered. The subject should fill around 2/4 of the total image size. The image must use a 1:1 aspect ratio in webp format and named FAN-SGL-GEN002-0002.webp
